services.desc: Your Greatest Adventure on Maui! Peaceful, serene, private, ecofriendly Whale Watch or Coastal Cruise with the gorgeous West Maui Coastline guiding you along the water Whale ONLY guaranteed December 1st - April 1st Otherwise this is a Costal and Wildlife tour only. 2.5 Hours About One of the most incredibly moving experiences on Maui. Enjoy the scenic West Maui Mountains, cool ocean breeze and the exciting West Maui wildlife with a guided private party kayak cruise. Make this a serene trip or party it up! Spend your time snorkeling Turtle Gardens Ages 8+ • 3 Hours • Fish, Snorkel, Whale Watch, & more! Customize Your Kayak Tour

services.name: Group Bottom Fishing Tour
services.desc: Book Your Hawaii Fishing Adventure! 3.5 Hours About HANDS FREE KAYAK FISHING! Bring the whole family or travel group and have a great day out on the water experiencing the FAMOUS "Hawaii Kayak Fishing". Made popular by Sport Illustrated in a 2017 article - we have clients come from world wide to experience fishing on a kayak on MAUI, some of the BEST fishing in the world. Hawaii provides some of the most exotic and exciting bottom fish varieties in the world - including great eating fish like Opakapaka, Ulua, Kahala, Uku, Manpache and more! Grab your kiddos, friends and family, hop Ages 8+ • 3.5 Hours • Catch dinner from a hands-free kayak with your family or group!
